arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ.
translation: No need to worry. It is a purification from sins, if Allah wills.

arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ. (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you. (Recite seven times)
